interpretation: The full-matrix failures move between different visits (6, 7, 15, 18) and different cases across identical-code runs, with magnitudes 10-165, while every isolated reproduction attempt (single render, pre-rolled render, back-to-back repeat) is bit-exact or within the classified glyph-edge residue. The divergence is therefore an intermittent, timing/resource-pressure-dependent race in the native raster pipeline (per-frame iframe realm + font measurement loop + bitmap handoff), not a deterministic geometry or compositing error.

excluded: deterministic geometry divergence (grain-omitted renders are bit-exact)
simple repeat nondeterminism (back-to-back same-frame renders are bit-exact)
font settle race (adding document.fonts.ready wait did not change the failure distribution)
checkpoint drift (wasm identity 1b1906ee... verified identical across all runs)
uncommitted-workspace contamination (clean pin worktree at the pinned commit reproduces it)
remaining: iframe realm load/dispose timing under memory pressure (the 250ms dispose grace timer races the next realm's font decode)
createImageBitmap transfer vs canvas teardown ordering
font measurement sandbox float drift only under specific scheduling

decision: Gate stays at the evidence-backed classified-residue bound (max<=6, mae<0.025). The intermittent divergence is recorded as an independent defect for the consolidated acceptance phase; tooling added by this investigation (magnitude-sorted samples, parameterized diagnostic index, pre-roll, matrix cap, repeat probe) is retained for that phase.
scope: not an installed Electron/full-movie/export acceptance claim
